goal: Prevent premature termination and make governed repair tasks resumable after process, connector or conversation interruption.
retry_policy: The same action and state are bounded per strategy; exhaustion switches to a declared fallback or records BLOCKED.
resume_policy: Immutable binding plus exact workspace fingerprint; only FIXER_RUNNING may reconcile an in-scope source mutation after interruption.
completion_policy: COMPLETED requires evidence on every required condition and a final COMPLETED checkpoint with evidence.
unchanged_authorities: Stage 1-5 Goal, entity, output and Target DSL semantics
